headline: A 2018 law renamed the Postal Service facility at 430 Main Street in Clermont, Georgia, as the Zack T. Addington Post Office.
what_it_does: This law gives a name to a specific United States Postal Service building in Clermont, Georgia. The building is now called the Zack T. Addington Post Office. The law does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018, and the naming took effect when it was signed.
